delta.comment: BLOCKED BY OPEN P1 (F17) — DO NOT EXECUTE AS WRITTEN. This task requires a suite that passes against today's unmodified start.sh across "the same seven dimensions" as the PowerShell suite. That is UNSATISFIABLE: verified against the working tree, start.sh (80 lines) implements only .env.local no-clobber parsing with quote stripping (lines 20-36), a COPILOT_HOME default (54), an unguarded export GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" (56), Copilot exe resolution (57-64), and exec "$copilot_exe" "$@" (66). It has NO ENGRAM_DATA_DIR default (line 55 is commented out), NO GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN handling, and NO COPILOT_USE_REMOTE/--remote logic (zero occurrences each), plus no backlogit sync and no Engram pre-warm. Three of the seven dimensions simply do not exist in start.sh. The upstream plan premise that start.ps1 and start.sh are "two divergent implementations of the same policy" is factually wrong for start.sh, and the same overstated premise underpins the 004-SP PROCEED reconciliation and the composability decision doc. Resolution requires separating shared behavior from PowerShell-only behavior and treating any cross-platform normalization as an explicit behavior change (which S1's zero-behavior-change rule forbids). Raised by PR #325 Copilot review after the 3-cycle budget was exhausted; recorded OPEN and escalated. NOTE: this task is a member of 127-S, so 127-S is NOT safely claimable until F17 is dispositioned. See docs/reviews/... (Cycle 4, F17). Stale cross-references to retired 117.001-T and 117.018-T were separately corrected to live IDs 118.001-T and 120.007-T.

SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION EVENT — F17 IS RESOLVED AND THIS TASK IS NOT BLOCKED (ruling D, 2026-08-12). This event supersedes the earlier "BLOCKED BY OPEN P1 (F17) — DO NOT EXECUTE AS WRITTEN" event on this log. That event is preserved above as history and is NO LONGER THE CURRENT STATE; log-based consumers MUST read this event as authoritative, and 127-S is NOT gated by F17.

WHAT WAS ACCEPTED. The earlier event was factually right that start.sh does not implement the same seven dimensions as start.ps1 — it has NO ENGRAM_DATA_DIR default, NO GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN handling, and NO COPILOT_USE_REMOTE/--remote logic. The resolution was NOT to force a false parity premise but to accept the divergence and re-scope this task: it is a CHARACTERIZATION SUITE FOR start.sh's OWN contract, asserting the missing dimensions AS OBSERVABLE ABSENCES. It is explicitly NOT a parity suite.

CURRENT CONTRACT. Two of the absences pinned here are named APPROVED MIGRATION DELTAS and are BASELINE EVIDENCE, NOT PERMANENT PRODUCT MANDATES: "no ENGRAM_DATA_DIR default" is the baseline for POSIX_ENGRAM_DATA_DIR, and "no GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" is the baseline for POSIX_PAT_BOOTSTRAP. Both are POSIX entries in the three-delta platform/scenario matrix owned by 120.007-T (ruling A, 2026-08-12); the third delta, WINDOWS_PAT_NO_GH, lands on 118.001-T and is not pinned here. Those two assertions are REPLACED, not preserved, after migration; every other scenario remains byte-equivalent.

STATUS: NOT BLOCKED. Executable as written.
